name: Grief
source:
Morning starts normally, but news of an accident shakes my day. I continue with work, carrying the quiet weight of grief.

[From [url=https://ashlex.itch.io/grief]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
早上照常开始，但事故的消息却让我的一天震惊不已。我继续工作，默默承受着悲伤的重担。
